verdicts.reason: Both are near-copies of the original at almost the same size, so neither one actually rearranges the layout. Both have the same two serious flaws: a grey 'missing asset' placeholder box at bottom right sits on top of the legal line and cuts it off, and the 'AWARD WINNING 2026' pill is dark on a dark background, so it nearly disappears. The headline is also so long that it crowds out the tiny product bottle. The only differences are small. A's body copy is set wider, so its lines run longer, and the SUNSET SALE ribbon still runs off the top-right corner. B moves the ribbon slightly inward and the CTA slightly down. Neither change makes one meaningfully better than the other.
